notes: Fix 1 (p14/p10 order): the booklet adds the 2x4 plate p10 from underneath at step 14, after the 4x8 plate p14 at step 10. A later piece cannot be listed under an earlier one. So p14 now lists no support, and p10 sits at layer 0 in front of p14, with no cell overlap. They are joined in other_joins, because the booklet clutches p10 to p14's underside. This is an approximation of the picture.

Fix 2 (groups): the 2x4 plate is joined to the pyramid, and each sword is joined to the shield held by the same mummy minifigure. The mummy minifigures are not in the piece list, so that join is an assumption. Two groups stay separate on purpose. The motorcycle (steps 1-9) and the pyramid with the golden staff (steps 10-26) are two separate models in the booklet, so they are never joined. The two mummies are separate minifigures too.
All pyramid layers use p14 as layer 0. The motorcycle has its own layer 0.

Step numbers count the motorcycle steps 1-3, the page-6 sub-assembly as steps 4-7, motorcycle steps 4-5 as steps 8-9, and pyramid steps 1-17 as steps 10-26. Step 8 adds no piece of its own. Swords and shields have step 27 and no grid position.
Positions on the pyramid are approximated from the isometric drawings.

The headlight plate p11 and its two clear round plates p47 and p48 sit sideways on the front of the bike, so p11 has no grid position. I assumed they rest on p11. The fairing and wheels also have no grid position.
